description: Source code for the Kubernetes client application in Apache Spark, responsible for submitting Spark jobs to Kubernetes, managing driver pods, and monitoring application status.

classes.name: ClientArguments
classes.description: Encapsulates arguments for Spark Kubernetes submission client, including main resource, class, driver args, and proxy user.

classes.name: Client
classes.description: Handles the submission of Spark applications to Kubernetes, including pod creation, resource management, and application monitoring.

classes.name: KubernetesClientApplication
classes.description: Main entry point for Spark application submission in Kubernetes mode, parses arguments, and initiates the client run process.

methods.name: fromCommandLineArgs
methods.description: Parses command line arguments to create a ClientArguments instance.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes the application submission process, including resource setup, pod creation, and optional waiting for app completion.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Entry point for SparkApplication, initiates argument parsing and run process.
